CodeunitName: Test Tbl Evt Async Sub Error
Note: The System Application's OnBeforeInsertEvent subscriber on 'Retention Policy Setup' (3901) must refuse a table that is not on the allowed list, and its Error() must reach the caller. It does not: the asserterror sees no error at all ('An error was expected inside an ASSERTERROR statement'), so the write the subscriber exists to refuse goes through. Same root as #2932 -- TABLE-event subscribers declared in an already-compiled app. The positive control in the same codeunit, TableEventSubscriberInAnotherApp_TemporaryInsertIsNotRefused, passes. Green on real BC 27.0 through 28.4. Arrived with the pin bump in AlRunner#3061 and reproduces on unmodified main at that pin.
